7zip.description: 7-Zip is a free and open-source file archiver utility. It supports several compression formats and provides a high compression ratio, making it a popular choice for file compression.

advancedip.description: Advanced IP Scanner is a fast and easy-to-use network scanner. It is designed to analyze LAN networks and provides information about connected devices.

angryipscanner.description: Angry IP Scanner is an open-source and cross-platform network scanner. It is used to scan IP addresses and ports, providing information about network connectivity.

anydesk.description: AnyDesk is a remote desktop software that enables users to access and control computers remotely. It is known for its fast connection and low latency.

audacity.description: Audacity is a free and open-source audio editing software known for its powerful recording and editing capabilities.

autoruns.description: This utility shows you what programs are configured to run during system bootup or login

chromium.description: Chromium is the open-source project that serves as the foundation for various web browsers, including Chrome.

esearch.description: Everything Search is a fast and efficient file search utility for Windows.

firefox.description: Mozilla Firefox is an open-source web browser known for its customization options, privacy features, and extensions.

lightshot.description: Ligthshot is an Easy-to-use, light-weight screenshot software tool, where you can optionally edit your screenshots using different tools, share them via Internet and/or save to disk, and customize the available options.

localsend.description: An open source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop.

notepadplus.description: Notepad++ is a free, open-source code editor and Notepad replacement with support for multiple languages.
